description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vizier of Many Faces that has haste. Choose to have Vizier of Many Faces enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Vizier of Many Faces token instead.
